proposal: Reject a present top-level prompt_eval_cached_count unless it is an integer zero, in addition to the existing usage.cached_input_tokens check. A caller claiming fully uncached Ollama must also require the known telemetry field to be present; absence is unknown, not proof of zero.
targeted_test_cases: positive usage field rejected even when top-level zero
positive top-level count rejected even when usage zero
scope: Source proposal only, not applied to the shared harness or any frozen source.
